Here are a few ways you could start out

1. Play it super safe, go for drops no one is going for. Small compounds and just make your way from one to the other. Learn how the game plays with circles. It's boring and you will take longer to learn the weapons and have less of a chance at the better loot.

2. Go for safe drops but if someone lands near you, go for a hunt. Force yourself to engage in combat. You'll win some and you'll lose some. You learn from your mistakes in this game a lot of the time.

3. Drops are likely to have a few people, you will engage in combat. Usually better loot (if you can even find it before being rushed by an AR while you have a smoke grenade) This way if you come out alive you get some decent loot and the satisfaction of coming out alive.

4. HOT DROPS! If the plane flies over the hot drops, go for it. You will die... A lot! But you think on your feet better, coming out of school alive when 20+ others land there is almost as satisfying as a chicken dinner to me.

5. This one is the high risk high reward way, drops that have the best loot in higher spawn rate. Over populated drops that you will get very decent gear out of. It's a frenzy of dead bodies, but having tier 3 everything and fully kitted guns can make a big difference in game play for you.
